title.narrative: Promoting the Development of Biogas Energy Amongst Select Small- and Medium-Sized Agro-Industries

description.narrative: Related to preparation phase ID 100179: The project aims to reduce GHG emissions by promoting investment and market development of biogas energy technologies in select agro-industries in Chile. This project was requested by the Renewable Energy Centre of Chile (CER) - now CIFES - to UNIDO through the GEF operational focal point at the Ministry of Environment of Chile as part of the Government of Chile's efforts to mitigate climate change.
